description: Generate a validated, deterministic Schema.org JSON-LD @graph payload for SoftwareApplication, Organization, FAQPage, Article, Product, or WebSite entities. Use this tool to create copy-pasteable structured data that maximizes Google Rich Results eligibility and improves entity disambiguation inside LLM knowledge graphs. Returns a validated JSON-LD object, an HTML script tag snippet ready for <head> injection, and entity graph completeness metrics.

description.description: Concise factual summary of the entity optimized for search snippets and LLM citations.

entity_type.description: Primary Schema.org entity type to generate in the @graph payload.

faq_items.description: Optional FAQ question-and-answer pairs to embed as a linked Schema.org FAQPage node.

name.description: Canonical brand, software product, organization, or article title (e.g., "Argosor").

pricing_offers.description: Optional list of pricing tiers to embed as Schema.org Offer nodes.

name.description: Plan or offer tier name (e.g., "Starter Plan").

price_usd.description: Monthly or unit price in USD (e.g., 19).

url.description: Canonical HTTP/HTTPS URL for the entity (e.g., "https://argosor.com").

name: schema_jsonld_generator
title: Deterministic Schema.org JSON-LD Graph Generator
